chapters.title: AI GUARD | Product tour
chapters.description: A walkthrough of the running frontend using synthetic demo data.

chapters.title: 01 | Prevention at every layer
chapters.description: Input inspection, permission-filtered retrieval, and output protection.

chapters.title: 02 | Choose a workspace
chapters.description: Start with Individual or Company; company accounts then choose a role.

chapters.title: 01 | Welcome to AI Guard
chapters.description: Choose personal protection or an organization workspace.

chapters.title: 02 | Company roles
chapters.description: Administrator, limited employee, and normal employee map to verified demo identities.

chapters.title: 03 | Administrator sign-in
chapters.description: The role filters the account list. Backend credentials determine actual permissions.

chapters.title: 04 | Security overview
chapters.description: Live dashboard: monitored requests, prevention outcomes, risk, and recent events.

chapters.title: 05 | Secure AI chat
chapters.description: Choose a prompt or a synthetic security scenario, then send it through the gateway.

chapters.title: 06 | Safe requests are allowed
chapters.description: The offline demo model receives the inspected request and returns a protected response.

chapters.title: 07 | Personal data protection
chapters.description: Load synthetic personal data to demonstrate masking before the model is called.

chapters.title: 08 | Explainable gateway evidence
chapters.description: Masked identifiers, detector confidence, and policy IDs explain the decision.

chapters.title: 09 | Prompt injection defense
chapters.description: Instruction overrides are blocked before reaching the model.

chapters.title: 10 | Untrusted document defense
chapters.description: Document-borne instructions are inspected before model context is accepted.

chapters.title: 11 | Confidential review workflow
chapters.description: Sensitive business requests can be held for administrator review before model execution.

chapters.title: 12 | Live security monitor
chapters.description: Review content-free audit events, filter outcomes, and inspect individual incidents.

chapters.title: 13 | Security analytics
chapters.description: Review measured enforcement outcomes, category breakdowns, and policy effectiveness.

chapters.title: 14 | Policy management
chapters.description: Inspect policy actions, thresholds, and scope. Mandatory controls remain enforced.

chapters.title: 15 | Human review queue
chapters.description: Confidential requests appear as metadata-only review records; this demo rejects the held request.

chapters.title: 16 | Document security
chapters.description: Administrators inspect classification, ownership, and explicit document permissions.

chapters.title: 17 | Document creation form
chapters.description: Classification, content, and allowed users or roles can be configured before saving.

chapters.title: 18 | Authorized document retrieval
chapters.description: Test retrieval checks the signed-in identity before passing approved context to the model.

chapters.title: 19 | Evaluation and benchmarking
chapters.description: Measured results from synthetic fixtures, including precision, recall, and enforcement checks.

chapters.title: 20 | Normal employee access
chapters.description: Alice has assigned document permissions and no organization-wide administration.

chapters.title: 21 | Authorized employee retrieval
chapters.description: Alice can retrieve the synthetic Orion budget because her backend identity is permitted.

chapters.title: 22 | Limited employee boundaries
chapters.description: Bob can use the assistant, but restricted company content remains inaccessible.

chapters.title: 23 | Individual login
chapters.description: Personal accounts skip company role selection and enter their own restricted workspace.

chapters.title: 24 | Password visibility and validation
chapters.description: Show or hide the password; incorrect credentials return a clear sign-in error.

chapters.title: 25 | Personal workspace
chapters.description: The individual identity has secure chat and permitted documents, with no admin navigation.

chapters.title: 26 | Secure sign-out
chapters.description: Sign out ends the session and returns to the public AI Guard experience.
